basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Canada. I've been playing Minecraft and specifically Hypixel Skyblock for over a decade. I enjoy sharing tips and tricks with the community, and I'm always on the lookout for the latest gaming and tech news. When I'm not gaming, I'm working as a software developer. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends. I love engaging in discussions about tech innovations and gaming strategies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having completed my degree at the University of Toronto. I am self-taught in game mechanics and have been part of the Skyblock community since its inception. My professional experience as a software developer gives me a deep understanding of technology and coding.
